volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

harmonics.tooltip: Maximum partials (1…1024). The final slope lives on Additive Out.

waveform.tooltip: Trisaw / Saw / Square / PulseCenter / PulseLeft / PulseRight / Triangle / RectSine / Even / Odd. Morph is Trisaw peak (0.5 = triangle, 0/1 → saw) and Pulse* duty. Even / Odd keep every partial at equal amplitude; Even keeps the fundamental.

morph.tooltip: Trisaw: 0.5 = triangle, 0 or 1 → saw. Pulse*: duty (0.5 = 50%). Ignored by Saw / Square / Triangle / RectSine / Even / Odd.

phaseRotation.tooltip: Adds the same phase offset (cycles) to every harmonic in the Graph.

harmonicFade.tooltip: Instant = hard H snap (no amp crossfade). Smoothed = 1-quantum amp lerp on slot-count change (default). Decimal = live trailing partial amp from fractional Harmonics (no quantum lerp).

quantization.tooltip: How many index bins. 0 = off. 2 = halves, 4 = quarters. Audio bins by index (stable under fund sweep).

phaseMode.tooltip: Stagger = Bubble-like curve staircase (series of phase jumps). Random = old seeded random per bin.

depth.tooltip: Stagger: cascade depth in cycles (like Bubble Phase Skew). Scales the curve staircase.

curve.tooltip: Bend the stagger map (−1…+1). With Curve Kind = Log, this is the log-freq-style cascade bend (Bubble Skew Amount).

curveKind.tooltip: Shape of the stagger staircase. Logarithmic matches Bubble’s log cascade.

offset.tooltip: Add a constant phase to every bin after the staircase.

jump.tooltip: Extra phase step added per bin index (bin × Jump). Pure staircase on top of the curve.

bias.tooltip: Shift the curve input t before mapping (−1…+1). Slides which bins sit on the steep part of the log curve.

invert.tooltip: Flip the cascade (high bins get the low end of the curve).

frequency.tooltip: Fundamental in Hz. A cable on ƒ replaces this, one value per sample.

curve.tooltip: Final mask after Sync and every other Yellow Graph processor. Rational = one-sided bend. Bipolar Rational = S-curve between Slope Start and Slope End.

slopeStart.tooltip: Harmonic number (decimal) where the slope begins. Partials below it stay at full level. Tracks pitch because it is in ratio units.

slopeEnd.tooltip: Harmonic number (decimal) where the slope reaches 1 − Slope Height. Always stays above Slope Start.

skew.tooltip: Bend of the Slope Curve (−1…+1). 0 = straight line from Slope Start to Slope End.

slope.tooltip: 0…1. Linear amplitude drop from Slope Start to Slope End on the finished spectrum. Partials past Slope End sit at 1 − Slope Height.

seed.tooltip: Random phase seed for newly added partials (Phase Entry = Random).

noise.tooltip: CheapWalk / CheapFilteredNoise = quantum targets, linear-ramped at Out. WhiteNoise = audio-rate (Speed ignored).

add.tooltip: Additive pan jitter: pan' = pan + noise×Add. Simple add — no stagger/slope. Additive Out clamps to full L…R (−1…+1).

speed.tooltip: Quantum rate for CheapWalk / CheapFilteredNoise. Ignored for WhiteNoise.

seed.tooltip: Deterministic noise streams (Seed + harmonic index). Same Seed → same pattern.

rate.tooltip: Clock rate in Hz. Wired ƒ cancels Rate (absolute Hz), same as oscillators.

pulseStart.tooltip: Where in the cycle the gate goes high. Quantized to whole samples.

pulseEnd.tooltip: Where in the cycle the gate goes low. Quantized to whole samples.

mode.tooltip: Free follows live Duration, Shape, and Amplitude. Latch captures them at each trigger.

decayTime.tooltip: Seconds from Trigger height to 0.001 (hyperbolic amp-shape).

shape.tooltip: Exp time warp on the hyperbolic curve. 0 = linear time.

amplitude.tooltip: Output scale. Out = hyperbolic(Trigger height → 0.001) × Amplitude.

interpolation.tooltip: Delay-line fractional read. Linear (default). Hidden — enable from the parameter visibility menu.

pingPong.tooltip: PingPong Off = parallel stereo delay. Left Right = L→R bounce. Left Middle Right = taps at T / 2T / 3T panned L, center, R.

timeNumerator.tooltip: Numerator of Numer/Denom × whole note. Numer=0 → no delay. Examples: 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32.

timeDenominator.tooltip: Denominator of Numer/Denom × whole note. At Numer=1: Denom 4=¼, 8=⅛, 16=1/16, 32=1/32.

timingMode.tooltip: Normal = Numer/Denom as written. Dotted = 1.5×. Triplet = 2/3×.

offset.tooltip: Static trim (ms) of the tempo-base delay on both taps: delay = tempoBase + Offset + LFO_Amp×lfo. Not LFO depth — that is LFO Amp. Negative shortens, positive lengthens. Sample-accurate — pitches when swept or MOD’d.

lfoStyle.tooltip: Shape of the built-in delay-time modulator. Parabol / Random Walk / FBM.

lfoRate.tooltip: LFO speed in Hz (0…20). Speed only — depth is LFO Amp (ms). Gold LFO L/R outs move whenever Rate > 0, even if Amp is 0.

lfoAmp.tooltip: How far the LFO moves delay time (ms) around (tempoBase + Offset). Default 25 ms is audible wow; 0 = tempoBase+Offset only (Rate still drives gold LFO outs). Unlike Delay Mod (fraction of delay time), this depth is absolute milliseconds.

lfoVariation.tooltip: Detunes L vs R LFO rates so the two delays don’t lock together.

lpfFrequency.tooltip: Passive one-pole lowpass in the feedback loop (darkens repeats). 0 Hz holds (closed); DSP caps at Nyquist. Slider min/max are guides only.

hpfFrequency.tooltip: Passive one-pole highpass in the feedback loop (thins mud / DC). Slider min/max are guides only; DSP caps at Nyquist.

hpfShelf.tooltip: Feedback HPF mix: dry + Shelf x (filtered - dry). 100% = full filter.

lpfShelf.tooltip: Feedback LPF mix: dry + Shelf x (filtered - dry). 100% = full filter.

feedback.tooltip: Feedback into the saturated tape loop. Saturate soft-clips. >1 can self-oscillate.

saturate.tooltip: Soft clip in the feedback path (tape grunge). Lower = harder saturation; higher = cleaner.

mix.tooltip: Dry/wet mix on Mix L / Mix R.

seed.tooltip: LFO random (walk / FBM) seed. Same Seed = same modulation.

upShape.tooltip: Rising glide curve. Lin = constant rate. Log = fast start, eases in. Exp = slow start, finishes quickly. Smooth = slow start and end.

downShape.tooltip: Falling glide curve. Lin = constant rate. Log = fast start, eases in. Exp = slow start, finishes quickly. Smooth = slow start and end.

upTime.tooltip: Seconds to reach a higher target from the current value (any amplitude — Hz, CV, audio). 0 = instant.

downTime.tooltip: Seconds to reach a lower target from the current value (any amplitude). 0 = instant.

bias.tooltip: Offset added before slew (0…1). Hidden by default — show it to step the target by hand.
